workflows.handoffs: Approve, queue or reject back to the proposing lead

agents.name: Co-marketing Planner
agents.job: Packages esports, creator and paid support into partner launch proposals
agents.inputs: Beat calendar, creator and paid plans

agents.name: Partner Health Monitor
agents.job: Tracks partner volumes and flags expansion or churn risk

workflows.name: Target account build
workflows.trigger: Quarterly, or a new-title alert from Intelligence
workflows.inputs: Demand rank, partner list, payment-gap model
workflows.handoffs: Researcher and Modeller to the Outreach Drafter

workflows.name: Partner launch
workflows.inputs: SKU list, countries, launch date
workflows.handoffs: Co-marketing plan to Command, which adds a calendar beat
workflows.gate: Partnerships lead and Head of Growth approve

workflows.name: Proof refresh
workflows.inputs: Blended results, payment success by method
workflows.handoffs: Case Study Builder to Discovery for site updates
workflows.gate: Legal and partner approval before publishing

teams.kpis: Qualified pipeline by product; lead response time; pilot-to-gateway conversion; partner volume growth; proof points published
